methodology.server: One persistent server; first timed file follows readiness, other files reuse the loaded model. No claim of cold OS cache.
methodology.request: Loopback proxy times POST /v1/chat/completions through complete response body. Includes proxy/HTTP overhead; llama.cpp token timings are separate.
methodology.cache: llama.cpp --cache-ram 0; slot/prompt behavior otherwise defaults. Repeated identical prompts can reuse the runtime prompt cache.
methodology.resources: Sampled every 1 second from server spawn, including startup where captured. GPU usage includes other applications; process working set is not private allocation. Peaks are approximate.
methodology.dataset: Original examples and proposed Russian references authored by Ulya (AI assistant) for this report; not human-reviewed translations or a release holdout.
methodology.scope: 20 standalone Chinese lines; prompt v5, no context or glossary, synthetic CRLF SRT. Proposed references are not sent to the model. Not a subtitle holdout or language-release gate.
methodology.currency: Recognized source amounts are protected as ordered tokens in inference-only text, then restored by the adapter after token validation. Raw candidate and accepted_candidate differ intentionally. Unrecognized amounts remain model translated.
